completeness.why: copyPreviousMonth and setZero call shouldFillCategory (setZero with explicit includeHidden), the three averages take their category set from getCategoriesForAverage (shouldFillCategory with requireGroup, the SQL hidden filters removed), and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount; no site keeps its own part of the selection or sign rule.

interface.why: shouldFillCategory takes only the real variation as two named options (includeHidden for setZero, requireGroup for the missing-group difference), making both preserved inconsistencies explicit; slight awkwardness in that includeHidden short-circuits requireGroup and setZero now fetches group_hidden it ignores.

disguised_duplication.where: The income/hidden checks and the sign inversion are removed from all sites and replaced by calls; the three identical average queries collapse into getCategoriesForAverage.
